summary: Pricing & Billing System Testing - Iteration 12. Complete testing of 4-tier pricing system with Stripe integration. All backend APIs passed (21/21 tests). Frontend UI displays correctly with Monthly/Annual toggle working, proper pricing displayed, and Stripe checkout redirection working.

GET_pricing_plans.details: Returns all 4 tiers (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with correct pricing and features

POST_checkout_create.details: Creates Stripe checkout sessions for paid tiers (starter, pro, enterprise). Returns checkout_url pointing to stripe.com

POST_subscribe_free.details: Creates free tier subscription, correctly rejects duplicate subscriptions

GET_subscription.details: Returns subscription details with tier_details, feature_flags, and limits

pricing_page_ui.details: All 4 pricing cards displayed with correct data-testid attributes

billing_toggle.details: Monthly/Annual toggle switches prices correctly (Annual: $23/$63/$199, Monthly: $29/$79/$249)

plan_selection_buttons.details: Free shows 'Get Started', paid tiers show 'Subscribe', redirects to login when not authenticated

stripe_checkout_redirect.details: After login, clicking Subscribe redirects to stripe.com checkout with correct amount ($278.39 for annual Starter)

passed_tests: ✅ No subscription user returns has_subscription: false
✅ Authenticated user redirected to Stripe checkout
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React Hook useEffect warning in PricingPage.jsx about missing dependencies (non-critical)
Minor: Redis not available warning in backend (using in-memory cache fallback - acceptable for this feature)
